edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender to equal _owner before ownership transfer
onlyGovernance requires msg.sender to be the governance contract
mapToken is guarded by onlyGovernance restricting msg.sender
setNextHeaderBlock is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner
depositBulk depends on onlyWhenUnlocked and pulls funds from msg.sender
challenge bond is refunded to msg.sender after a successful challenge
processExits performs an unchecked low level call into the exit predicate
malicious predicate can re-enter processExits or other withdraw manager entry points
ETH bond is sent to exitor with send after the external predicate call
challengeExit sends the bond to msg.sender with a low level send call
safeTransferFrom invokes the receiver hook letting an attacker re-enter before state settles
the receiver hook can be the deposit manager creating a re-entrant deposit block
sendBond forwards ETH to the withdraw manager, which can trigger fallback logic
onFinalizeExit delegates asset movement to depositManager.transferAssets
depositEther forwards msg.value into an external WETH deposit call
transferAssets calls external WETH withdraw or token transfer before state is final
depositBulk executes repeated external transferFrom calls that can re-enter
insert combines priority and value with unchecked bit shifts and or
processExits compares exitableAt with block.timestamp making payout miner dependent
processExitsBatch iterates and calls processExits for each token

renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable to the zero address
onlyWhenUnlocked reads the locked flag before depositBulk proceeds
syncState requires registrations[receiver] to equal msg.sender
register writes and reads the registrations mapping entry for the receiver

setNextHeaderBlock rewrites _nextHeaderBlock after deleting old header blocks
updateDepositId derives the deposit id from currentHeaderBlock based on _nextHeaderBlock

challengeExit burns the exit NFT which implicitly prevents double challenges

the created deposit block synchronizes state to the cached childChain address
onlyGovernance authorization is resolved by comparing msg.sender to the governance state var

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner parameter is only used to update _owner inside transferOwnership
_key parameter is only used as the contractMap key in updateContractMap
_address parameter is only stored into contractMap in updateContractMap
_rootToken parameter is only used inside mapToken
_childToken parameter is only used inside mapToken
_isERC721 parameter is only recorded by mapToken
_priority parameter is only packed into the heap element in insert
_value parameter is only packed into the heap element in insert
receiver parameter is only used for the registration check in syncState
data parameter is only emitted by syncState
sender parameter is only written into registrations by register
receiver parameter is only used as the registrations key in register
_token parameter only selects the asset branch in transferAssets
_user parameter is only the transfer destination in transferAssets
_amountOrNFTId parameter is only the transferred amount in transferAssets
_tokens array is only iterated inside depositBulk
_amountOrTokens array is only iterated inside depositBulk
_user parameter is only the deposit beneficiary in depositBulk
_user parameter is only the deposit beneficiary in onERC721Received
_tokenId parameter is only the deposit amount in onERC721Received
data parameter is only decoded inside verifyInclusion
exitor parameter is only stored into the PlasmaExit in addExitToQueue
exitId parameter is only the queue priority in addExitToQueue
predicate parameter is fixed to msg.sender inside addExitToQueue
exitId parameter only indexes the exits mapping in challengeExit
challengeData parameter is only forwarded to verifyDeprecation in challengeExit
adjudicatorPredicate parameter only selects the adjudicating predicate in challengeExit
_token parameter only selects the exit queue inside processExits
age parameter is only the input key in addInput
utxoOwner parameter is only stored into the Input struct in addInput
token parameter is only stored into the Input struct in addInput
sigs parameter is only forwarded to checkSignatures in submitCheckpoint
numDeposits parameter only advances the deposit counter in updateDepositId
_value parameter only rewrites _nextHeaderBlock in setNextHeaderBlock
exitQueue local only wraps exitsQueues[_token] inside processExits
currentExit local only caches exits[exitId] inside processExits
exitableAt local only participates in the timestamp comparison inside processExits
